title: Law to warn homeowners before DOB fines become tax liens
summary: This bill would require Department of Buildings violation notices that can lead to a tax lien to warn owners that an unpaid judgment may result in a lien on their property. Within three days of an Environmental Control Board judgment, DOB would have to notify the property owner with a plain-language explanation of the charge, payment options and deadlines, and steps to avoid or remove a lien. DOB and the Department of Finance would also have to publish annual data on lien conversions and provide outreach to owners of one- and two-family homes.
